posts.name: Clara AI SDR
posts.tagline: Turn website visitors into qualified pipeline
posts.description: Clara is an AI SDR that converts inbound website traffic into pipeline - engaging, qualifying, demoing, handling objections, and booking meetings in real time. No forms. No waiting. No extra headcount. 24/7 selling with seamless CRM integration.

posts.name: Taku AI
posts.tagline: Borrow the best AI setups and make them yours.
posts.description: AI is getting insanely powerful — and somehow harder to use. Taku fixes the last mile. It turns the best skills, agents, and workflows into real desktop apps anyone can run, remix, and make their own. Borrow setups from the pros, skip GitHub and setup, or just tell Taku what you want and watch it assemble the stack. The more you work, the more Taku learns what you need — and brings the right tools to you.

posts.name: Superflow AI
posts.tagline: AI agents that QA your website before launch
posts.description: Superflow turns the QA checklist you already use into a team of AI agents. They sweep every page, desktop and mobile, and pin every finding on the live site. Agents handle the black and white issues. Taste stays with you. Agents learn: rejected findings stop coming back, and misses become checks on future sites. Teams say they catch ~90% of what they found by hand. Works with Webflow, Framer, WordPress, Shopify, Next.js, Netlify + more.

posts.name: Hubble
posts.tagline: Retrieve medical records other APIs can't
posts.description: Medical records still live behind fax lines, phone trees, and portal logins nobody remembers. A patient verifies their identity once, and Hubble assembles their records from across their providers and returns them through one API, for your AI agent to use.

posts.name: ElevenLabs MCP in Claude
posts.tagline: Create and manage ElevenLabs voice agents in your chat
posts.description: Connect Claude to your ElevenLabs workspace to create and manage voice agents. Find existing agents, review their configuration, update prompts and voices, duplicate or delete agents.

posts.name: Shepherd Terminal
posts.tagline: A persistent terminal for Codex and Claude side by side
posts.description: Run coding agents across tabs, panes, and remote machines. Shepherd keeps terminal sessions alive when the app closes, tracks which agents are working or waiting, and lets you return to their files and changes without losing context. Agents understand the current Shepherd context, control tabs and panes, and collect feedback through browser reviews, while you monitor every agent’s status in real time.

posts.name: AirBuddy 3
posts.tagline: Easily manage devices and switch them between Macs
posts.description: AirBuddy 3 brings over 150 new features and improvements, including a new design, powerful new ways to keep an eye on your devices, deeper media integration, revamped Magic Handoff, and many new options for automation and customization.

posts.name: Reckon
posts.tagline: The decision journal that helps you calibrate
posts.description: Most decisions feel resolved the moment you make them. Reckon keeps what hindsight erases: the prediction, the confidence, the reasoning. Check-ins capture what changes before the outcome: new info tagged positive or negative, confidence updated. At resolution you log what happened; weeks later it asks if you'd still make the call. A year in, you see where confidence overshoots, where it undershoots, where judgment is sharpest. iPhone and iPad. iCloud sync, no account. One-time purchase.

posts.name: Tiny Funnel
posts.tagline: Funnel analytics you'll actually understand
posts.description: Funnel analytics you'll actually understand. Where visitors come from, how far each gets, and how many buy. Change the filters to a specific visitor set, e.g. "from Google" + "reached at least step two", and everything changes with you. The goal is answers and ideas as fast as possible, so filter options show their stats before you pick one. Cookie-less, so everyone gets counted. Scroll down for your funnel through time, and any visitor's full journey.

posts.name: Atlas by WorkOS
posts.tagline: Your AI coworker in Slack
posts.description: Atlas works alongside your team in Slack to answer questions, automate tasks, and help everyone do their best work.

posts.name: Clipwing Autopilot
posts.tagline: Get your clips without AI slop or hiring hassle
posts.description: Clipwing Autopilot isn't another AI clipper or another editing agency You upload a recording, choose your editing style, and receive consistent, ready-to-post clips without hiring editors, or jumping between Slack, Google Drive, and scheduling tools. Everything happens in one place No AI slop, no hiring hassle

posts.name: Finch
posts.tagline: A single place for your health data and tests
posts.description: Finch is a patient-side health companion built for all — an expecting parent, or just someone navigating the health system. Pregnancy alone involves at least 12 appointments, dozens of test results, and a new vocabulary, coming from different providers in different formats. That's just one example. Whatever your journey, Finch brings it into one clear view, transcribes what was said at your appointments, and translates clinical language into plain English. Free tier available. Finch+ $99/y

posts.name: CrewTower
posts.tagline: Control your agents from the notch
posts.description: Crew Tower lives in your MacBook notch and watches every AI coding agent you run: Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini, Qwen, OpenCode and more. When an agent needs permission, the request shows up in the notch with full context: the exact command, the file edit, the question. Approve or deny in one click, without touching the terminal. See every session at once, working, waiting or done. Jump straight to the right terminal window when one needs you. Nothing stalls silently.

posts.name: Dates by Agenda Hero
posts.tagline: Create a plan for anything. Share it with anyone.
posts.description: Say hello to Dates. The joyful way to plan the dates you share. The school calendar you share with 500 other families. The family calendar you share with everyone at home. The sales kickoff agenda you share with 70 colleagues. Right now, those dates are stuck in docs, sheets, PDFs, and email. Because there hasn't been a better way. Until today.

posts.name: Gauge
posts.tagline: Agent Led Growth: Get written into every customer's codebase
posts.description: Don’t use Gauge. Unless you want your tool to get written into every codebase. Agents are leading the next wave of growth for our customers including Supabase, Openrouter, Resend, PostHog, Mintlify, Braintrust, and more. Unlike AI chat, coding agents are implementing products autonomously. They're doing so without ever talking to a sales rep or taking a demo. Gauge runs real coding sessions to identify actions to improve the agent’s preference, and the agent experience once you’re selected.

posts.name: Deepmark
posts.tagline: Search your bookmarks by what's inside them, not the title
posts.description: Your browser bookmarks, X bookmarks, Instagram saves and YouTube Watch Later, in one private library you can search in plain language. Deepmark reads every page, transcribes videos and reels, describes and OCRs frames, then embeds it all. 'The reel with the one-pan pasta trick' finds the reel even though nothing in it says pasta. A save is searchable in about 90 seconds; search over 10k items returns in under 100ms. Also a hosted MCP server: your AI agent can search your library too.

posts.name: Open Index
posts.tagline: Build Smarter Agents using Structured Context
posts.description: Managing markdown based context comes with challenges like context poisoning, contradictions, non-determinism and context navigation difficulties. Over time, we built out a structured context management layer at our company (DrDroid) - with Open Index, we are sharing it with the ecosystem!

posts.name: LayerProof Matte 3.0
posts.tagline: Grow your social media content: posts, carousels and stories
posts.description: Paste your brand or product. LayerProof builds your brand kit, then creates 50 on-brand posts in one sitting with captions ready to publish, right from LayerProof. Fill your feed with high-converting content, co-designed with marketers and business owners across SaaS, FMCG, Food and Beverage, Consulting and more

posts.name: monolog
posts.tagline: Chat to yourself and find anything by what you remember
posts.description: Chat to yourself. monolog takes care of the rest. No titles, folders, or tags to manage. AI quietly understands what you write, recognizes schedules and tasks, and reminds you when it matters. Semantic search finds records by what they were about—even if you forgot the exact words you used. Everything stays synced across iOS, Android, Web, Desktop, and Chrome. Just write naturally. monolog handles the organizing, remembering, and finding later.

posts.name: Meterless.ai
posts.tagline: Run AI locally and own the whole workflow
posts.description: Most AI tools return an answer and discard the process. Meterless lets the real workflow run on your device—and makes it yours. Relay turns desktop work into reusable missions. Gaia keeps projects, memory, and context persistent. Swarms exposes the full agent graph. Replay, edit, switch models, and run the work again without starting over. Local-first, model-agnostic, and built so AI work compounds instead of disappearing.

posts.name: Salem Robotics
posts.tagline: Deploy autonomous robots for surveys and manipulation tasks
posts.description: Robot software brain for autonomous surveys, inspections, and manipulation in hazardous facilities. Instead of sending technicians in with handheld detectors and clipboards, an operator draws the route on a dashboard. The robot navigates, opens doors, turns valves, takes measurements, and returns a compliance-ready report with heatmaps and flagged risks. Hardware-agnostic, built on published research by PhD roboticists with a decade at Los Alamos. Deploy on your robot, or we provide one with it.

posts.name: Whisperstream
posts.tagline: Local AI dictation for Windows
posts.description: Local AI dictation for Windows. Push-to-talk hotkey, words paste into any window, transcription runs on your CPU so audio never leaves your machine. No cloud, no model trained on your voice. $29 one-time, no subscription. Free trial, no account.

posts.name: Skim Recap
posts.tagline: Recaps what you skipped and explains where you get stuck
posts.description: Flick through an article too fast and Skim Recap hands the skipped passage back in a card beside your cursor. If a term stops you, select the word or phrase and press Feynman: Gemma uses the surrounding paragraph, nearby context, heading, and page title to explain what it means here. Everything runs locally through LiteRT-LM and WebGPU—no account or hosted LLM API.

posts.name: Transept AI
posts.tagline: AI translation software with translation memory
posts.description: AI translation that remembers your decisions — every terminology and tone choice carries across documents, languages, and your team. Glossaries, styleguides, review, and translation memory built in.

posts.name: Controller AI
posts.tagline: Build deterministic agents that actually follow your process
posts.description: Define important business processes in a workflow, and attach it to your agent as tools. When your agent decides to take action, it runs your workflow - same steps, same output, every time.

posts.name: The AI Platform
posts.tagline: Maximizing Human Potential
posts.description: The AI Platform is a provider-agnostic AI superapp for multi-agent, multi-human organizations. Work with friends or coworkers, bring your own mini app and share it with the world.

posts.name: Forgot* Password
posts.tagline: Password manager for agencies handling many client password
posts.description: Forgot Password helps agencies securely store client logins, recovery details, 2FA setup keys, and account handoff context in one protected workspace.

posts.name: HeyZoku - Hands Free Coding
posts.tagline: Orchestrate army of coding agents just with voice. No Hands.
posts.description: The voice-first agentic dev environment for Mac. Run ten coding agents at once without babysitting them — spawn, redirect, and interrupt Claude, Codex, and Cursor by name, just by talking - all without hands. On-device speech, your own subscriptions, one-time price.

posts.name: MentionLeads
posts.tagline: Find high-intent customers before your competitors
posts.description: The growth system for your website. Find buyers on Reddit, X and Hacker News, connect traffic to revenue, and earn legitimate backlinks.

posts.name: Internet Is Beautiful
posts.tagline: Discover the most interesting, weird and awesome websites.
posts.description: A free weekly newsletter sharing the most interesting websites and useful tools on the internet, delivered every Wednesday.

posts.name: Kody Video
posts.tagline: Share your life experiences with the people you love
posts.description: Kody Video is an open source, offline web application you use to record video clips of your life experiences. When you've got all the clips you want, hit "Go" and it turns into a single video you can share with the people you love. With Kody Video Plus, you can trim clips, add music, and more. Videos are local to your device so your precious moments are only shared with those you choose.

posts.name: Pokobot
posts.tagline: Never forget anything ever again.
posts.description: Pokobot helps you remember your tasks, at the right time it pings you on Whatsapp with a Reminder. There is no website to visit or no app to install, you simply text Pokobot on whatsapp about your reminder in plain english and it sets it for you.

posts.name: Vidrip
posts.tagline: Send videos to friends. Get real reactions.
posts.description: Privately share clips with the friends who get it and react together - plus an invite-only circle of creators dropping unreleased work. Send a video, get a real reaction.

posts.name: Doko
posts.tagline: Turn saved places into personal guides you can actually use
posts.description: Doko turns the places scattered across screenshots, saved posts, Maps and notes into personal guides you can use on a trip or pass to a friend. Save a place, add your own context, organise it beautifully, and keep the recommendation useful when you need it.

posts.name: LastGood
posts.tagline: Telemetry tells you what. LastGood tells you why.
posts.description: Stop hunting logs during Sev-1 incidents. LastGood correlates telemetry alert spikes with upstream Git commits, feature flags, and Kubernetes deployments. Pinpoint root cause changes and get recommended rollback commands in 3 seconds.

posts.name: Freedium
posts.tagline: Read Medium articles on Freedium in one click
posts.description: Open any Medium article on Freedium with one click. No setup, no account, and no tracking. Works directly from Medium articles and your feed, with a lightweight, privacy-friendly experience.

posts.name: Frontrunners.io
posts.tagline: Find jobs before everyone else
posts.description: Frontrunners is a job search AI agent that helps you reach hiring managers directly at relevant companies. Instead of applying to 100s of jobs, that receive 1000s of applicants, it automates personalized outreach, often before roles are public. No more black-hole applications or ghosting. Frontrunners gets you direct conversations with hiring managers. Tell it the roles and companies you're targeting, and it finds the right decision-makers and crafts tailored, human-sounding emails for you.

posts.name: Timeln
posts.tagline: Your entire reading history, as context for any LLM
posts.description: Timeln makes your personal context instantly queryable across Claude and ChatGPT. It captures what you read, save, and decide behind the scenes, ensuring your insights stay intact across every AI tool you use. Tap ⌘C three times and whatever you're reading is saved: text, links, PDFs, screenshots. No folders, no tags, nothing to organise. Press ⌘\ in any app to find memories, or connect it with Claude or Cursor to answer from everything you've read.

posts.name: Xenaris 4.x
posts.tagline: The intelligence factory for private M&A
posts.description: Xenaris watches the private market continuously: standing Mandates sweep weekly, score sell-readiness on cited public signals, map likely buyers, and settle every call against real outcomes in an append-only ledger. Not another database - finished research.

posts.name: BrandVoice Pro
posts.tagline: Turn generic PLR content into content that sounds like you
posts.description: BrandVoice Pro turns generic PLR content into content that sounds like you. Save your brand profile once and our SPEAK Method personalizes every article and social post automatically. Built for solo business owners. There's no need to learn prompt engineering.

posts.name: Luna
posts.tagline: Your AI Chief of Staff for getting things done
posts.description: Luna is an AI Chief of Staff built for people who run things. Unlike chatbots that wait for prompts, Luna proactively works across your tasks, calendar, emails, and workflows to spot what is slipping through the cracks and help move it forward. Start with our Coordination Tax Audit to see how much time you lose to coordination, then let Luna take some of that work off your plate.

posts.name: StartupsBR
posts.tagline: Brazil's startups, mapped
posts.description: StartupsBR is a live map of startups building in Brazil. It's a visual, explorable view of the ecosystem by city, industry, and stage. StartupsBR is built specifically for the Brazilian scene: founders can find who's building nearby, discover companies hiring in their sector, and see the ecosystem grow city by city. So far, I have mapped São Paulo, Curitiba, Florianópolis and a few others.

posts.name: Prose Coach
posts.tagline: Write with AI. Just don't sound like it.
posts.description: AI gets the draft moving. It also repeats the same writing habits. Prose Coach marks all 43 patterns and returns each fix inside the AI tool you already use. Connect it in about two minutes. Three drafts a day, free.

posts.name: Tented AI
posts.tagline: AI runs your email marketing, landing pages & forms
posts.description: Tented began as an AI page builder. Today it becomes a full agentic marketing platform: an email studio that writes, designs, and codes email that renders everywhere; blasts sent from your verified domains; triggered multi-step journeys with personalized email/web engagement; a lightweight CRM; and an Agent API so that your agents can ship on-brand campaigns without you. The era of WYSIWYG and drag-and-drop is over. With Tented's AI Marketing Automation, if you can describe it, you can ship it.

posts.name: Salad
posts.tagline: AI models, apps, and team collaborating in one conversation.
posts.description: Salad is a collaborative AI workspace where ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok, Mistral, Perplexity, your apps, files, and teammates can work together in one shared conversation. Instead of switching tabs, repeating context, and comparing answers manually, Salad lets multiple AI models think together, debate ideas, write, research, plan, create docs, run polls, and move work forward with the same context.

posts.name: Toolbit.ai
posts.tagline: Find, compare & track the best AI tools - faster
posts.description: Toolbit.ai is the AI discovery platform that understands your intent. Instead of browsing endless lists, just describe the task and get the best matching tools, ranked and comparable. What’s new in this major update: (1) Natural language / intent search (jumped to 92% more accurate result) (2) Side-by-side tool comparisons (3) Traffic + community rankings (4) Live model tracking (GPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok…) (5) Live AI news, Social & updates

posts.name: GitGhost AI
posts.tagline: Make AI-built code reviewable before it ships
posts.description: GitGhost makes AI-built software reviewable before production. Connect Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, or OpenCode; capture session evidence; review branches and diffs; approve risky actions; run pipelines and security checks; and keep humans in charge of what ships.

posts.name: Finsee : Budget & Forecast
posts.tagline: See tomorrow's balance, today.
posts.description: Finsee shows you what your balance looks like next days, not just today. Add your income, expenses and subscriptions (or connect your bank, optional) and watch them project forward on a calendar. About to make a big decision? Simulate it first and see exactly how it changes your future balance, before you commit.

posts.name: Screenies
posts.tagline: AI App Store screenshot generator for iOS apps
posts.description: Most App Store screenshot tools are template editors. You still pick frames, write headlines, and design each slide. Screenies generates the full set with AI. Upload your real app screens, describe what the app does, and get one cohesive, on-brand set sized for the 6.9-inch iPhone display App Store Connect requires. Built for iOS founders who do not want to open Figma or hire a designer for every release. Pricing is $29/month or credit packs from $9. Credits never expire.

posts.name: Aivory AI
posts.tagline: Make AI Make Sense®
posts.description: Aivory is an AI-powered business transformation platform that helps companies turn operational complexity into clarity and also turn repetitive work into intelligent workflows. From AI readiness and workflow design to automation, governance, and monitoring, Aivory gives businesses one place to deploy AI safely and practically. Built for teams that want to move beyond AI experiments and make AI actually work inside their business.

posts.name: My Dream Colors
posts.tagline: Turn a kid's photo into their coloring book
posts.description: Upload your child's photo and interests — our AI creates a personalized coloring book with their face on every page. Printed and shipped to your door in days.

posts.name: Zync
posts.tagline: Local-first SSH workspace - local shells and remote servers
posts.description: An open-source, local-first SSH workspace that brings your terminal, SSH, SFTP, port forwarding, encrypted vault, snippets, and more into one place. Free to use with no feature paywalls and optional encrypted backups to your own Google Drive.

posts.name: myHERALD
posts.tagline: A week of researched, on-brand content in 20 minutes.
posts.description: Most AI writing tools give you a blank prompt box. myHERALD runs the content operation: it plans your week, researches live sources, drafts in your voice, fact-checks claims, creates visuals, and puts every piece in your review queue. Skills, knowledge, and editorial feedback stay in one workspace, so each run starts with context. Built for solo founders and marketers of one. 14-day free trial, no card required.

posts.name: OwlVigil
posts.tagline: Control AI access, cost, usage, and governance in one place
posts.description: OwlVigil is an enterprise AI control plane that helps teams manage AI access, spending, policies, usage, and model routing across providers and applications. With a lightweight integration and open-source SDK, teams get centralized visibility and real-time control over their AI stack—without rebuilding applications or locking into a single model provider.

posts.name: Checkpnt
posts.tagline: Letterboxd for games: rate, review and track what you play
posts.description: Build a catalogue of every game you've played, import your Steam library, follow friends and read their reviews, and post your reviews straight into your Discord server. Free, no ads, on web, iPhone and Android.

posts.name: Auramenta
posts.tagline: The journal that reads between the lines
posts.description: Auramenta is a private journal for iOS. You write, and an engine on your phone reads your entries back and surfaces recurring phrases and slow patterns over weeks. Tendencies, never verdicts. Eight languages, each with its own engine, and thousands of hand-written phrase rules across them. No LLM, no external AI service. No accounts, no tracking, no server of our own. What you write is encrypted on your phone. The optional iCloud backup is encrypted before it leaves. Free to start.

posts.name: NanoCount
posts.tagline: Countdown & count-up widgets for Apple, no subscription
posts.description: NanoCount counts down to what matters and counts the days up from what you are keeping going, on iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple Watch. The multi-event widget is free! Never a subscription, and everything stays on your device. Optional one-time Pro with premium options.

posts.name: Buildside
posts.tagline: Where founders build in public and grow together
posts.description: The future of SaaS founders' social network. Discover SaaS products, follow founders building in public, and learn from their real launches, experiments, milestones, and lessons.

posts.name: explain.ink
posts.tagline: Hand-drawn explainer videos from a topic or a document
posts.description: Give explain.ink a topic, a script or a document. It writes the story, draws every scene by hand, records the voiceover and renders your video.

posts.name: CompareLLMS
posts.tagline: Use multiple LLMs at once, privately!
posts.description: Compare AI Models - run one prompt across ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini. See every answer side by side, ask follow-ups, export as Markdown, and pick the best. 100% private.

posts.name: Quicktion 2.0
posts.tagline: Six destinations and a forwarding address for every email
posts.description: Quicktion started in 2023 as a Gmail add-on that saved emails to Notion. It now saves to Notion, Google Sheets, Google Drive, Airtable, Linear and Trello, and every destination gets its own forwarding address, so emails from Outlook, Apple Mail or anywhere else file themselves on arrival. On Pro, write a prompt and the AI pulls the fields you want out of the body and any attached PDFs. Invoice numbers, totals, dates, whatever you asked for.

posts.name: BellyMystery
posts.tagline: Food Intolerance Tracker
posts.description: Snap a photo of meals, tap to log symptoms and stools, and BellyMystery quietly builds the food diary a doctor, dietitian, or nutritionist would ask for. Get a plain-language pattern summary and an exportable report, right on your phone.

posts.name: Small Business Chatbot
posts.tagline: Your AI front desk assistant for your website
posts.description: Small Business Chatbot is an AI agent on your site that talks to your customers and books appointments for you. It automatically programs itself so it's ready to go in under a minute, and can be linked directly to your Calendar so that it can directly book, cancel, or reschedule service appointments. It also offers deep agent customization, and the ability to follow up with AI calls, texts, and emails, to make sure every prospect is booked. Only pay for warm leads and appointments.

posts.name: ActionLock: AI App Blocker
posts.tagline: Block distracting apps. Do exercise to unlock them.
posts.description: ActionLock turns screen time into workout time. Block distracting apps like TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, and X. When you try to open one, complete a quick set of push-ups, squats, or sit-ups to unlock 15-120 minutes of access. Every rep earns XP to level up and build your virtual character, complete quests, grow streaks, collect badges, and unlock new skins. Move more. Scroll less. 💪

posts.name: FeedbackFlow
posts.tagline: Feedback widget, public roadmap, AI changelog
posts.description: FeedbackFlow turns one script tag into a feedback widget, public roadmap, and AI changelog. Users submit bugs and ideas in-app, vote on what to build next, and see shipped work — with Jira sync. Setup in 5 minutes. From $19/mo.

posts.name: Dhyan Pay
posts.tagline: Budget your UPI spending — without linking your bank
posts.description: Scan any UPI QR, pick a spending wallet, and see the warning if you're over budget - then pay in your own UPI app with your own PIN. No bank linking, no SMS reading, no analytics companies. A notebook for your spending, made in India.

posts.name: EasyYMM
posts.tagline: Year/Make/Model fitment search for Shopify parts stores
posts.description: Every parts shopper asks the same thing first: will this fit my truck? EasyYMM answers it on the page. Upload your vehicles as a CSV, map SKUs in bulk or fit a whole collection at once, and shoppers filter your catalog by Year, Make and Model. Fitment is stored in your own Shopify metafields, and both the YMM filter and the per-product fitment widget install as theme blocks. No theme rebuild. For automotive, powersports, marine and equipment-parts stores.

posts.name: Bendstack
posts.tagline: Lovable but No Code plus Instant Deployment
posts.description: Bendstack is a Modular AI Development platform that helps you build web, mobile and desktop apps without writing a single line of code.

posts.name: Juvant Upsell & Cross Sell
posts.tagline: Shopify upsells at 5 touch points - not a growing app bill
posts.description: The best upsell doesn't feel like an upsell - it feels like the next thing a shopper already wanted. Juvant turns 5 Shopify touch points, from product page to thank-you page, into upsell and cross-sell moments. Control what appears with cart and product rules, preview scenarios in the Cart Simulator before publishing, and track revenue uplift, conversions, and AOV. Your first 100 orders containing a Juvant upsell are free; unlimited usage is $14/month. No volume tiers. No revenue caps.

posts.name: Khirby
posts.tagline: The self-hosted CRM that respects your data
posts.description: Khirby is an open-source, self-hosted CRM for B2B teams who want full control over their data. Contacts, pipeline, work boards, email, and a plugin SDK — all in one Docker deploy. No SaaS fees, no vendor lock-in, your server.

posts.name: Selluna.ai
posts.tagline: Turn product URLs into marketplace-ready image sets
posts.description: Selluna turns a product URL into a complete set of listing images (main, lifestyle, A+ and ad creatives) formatted to each platform’s rules. Built for sellers on Amazon, Shopify, eBay, Etsy and Walmart. No prompts or design skills needed.

posts.name: Coinage
posts.tagline: Keep your money invested until the moment you need it.
posts.description: Money you plan to spend sits in checking, earning nothing. Coinage is built on one belief: every dollar should be working until the second it's spent. Invest in diversified ETF portfolios called Nests, set a rule like "sell my gains at 5% toward my spending," and live your life. Coinage handles the selling automatically. Spend Match works in reverse: everyday purchases trigger small new investments. Invested and ready to spend, both at once.

posts.name: Roomsy
posts.tagline: Visualize Real Furniture In Your Home Before You Buy
posts.description: Imagine designing your dream room with furniture you can actually buy. Roomsy combines Pinterest-style inspiration, IKEA Place-like visualization, and The Sims-style creativity, letting you explore real brands, style your space, and see your ideas come to life

posts.name: Partida
posts.tagline: Watch chess like you watch football
posts.description: Your chess game, narrated like a broadcast. Paste a PGN, drop a Lichess link, or connect your account, and get an MP4 with a real narrator covering the opening, the turning point and the mistake that decided it. Live tournaments too, narrated as they happen, in 10 languages. Free to try.

posts.name: PoeysiaPRO
posts.tagline: Find the moments. Shape the shorts.
posts.description: PoeysiaPRO is a native macOS workspace for turning podcasts, interviews, talks and webinars into short-form videos. It finds strong moments, then lets you review, reframe, subtitle, caption and export them on your Mac. Media and rendering stay local. Use PoeysiaPRO’s included AI, or connect an AI subscription you already have, including ChatGPT, Claude or Grok.

posts.name: TokenTimer
posts.tagline: Certificate lifecycle automation without private-key custody
posts.description: TokenTimer discovers every certificate, token, secret and license you own, alerts the right people before expiry, and automates renewal where it matters. Cloud-managed SaaS or self-hosted, metadata-only security, source-available on GitHub.

posts.name: Barred
posts.tagline: A lightweight, open-source menu bar manager for macOS
posts.description: Barred keeps an overcrowded macOS menu bar under control. Hide rarely used icons in a collapsible secondary bar, reveal them with one click, reorder items, and choose when the bar hides itself again. It’s a small, native utility with no Dock icon, accounts, analytics, or network access.

posts.name: Facturisa
posts.tagline: AI invoice maker built for Swiss SMEs
posts.description: Facturisa is an AI invoicing tool for Swiss SMEs and trades — plumbers, electricians, small businesses who just need invoices done fast. Paste a product link, and AI turns it into a ready invoice line item. No manual entry, no accounting software to learn. Create Swiss-compliant invoices and offers, manage your customers and products, and get paid faster. Free tier: 50 offers and 25 invoices per month. Already used by 1,500+ Swiss SMEs.

posts.name: AVIF Converter
posts.tagline: Convert AVIF to JPG, PNG, and WebP in your browser

posts.name: ShotDock
posts.tagline: Full page screenshots that never leave your browser
posts.description: Open ShotDock, choose Full Page or Visible Area, and get one clean, complete image in seconds. The capture, the stitching and the encoding all happen inside your browser. There is no screenshot server, no upload step and no account to create, so a screenshot of an internal dashboard or a private document stays exactly where you took it.

posts.name: TweetyAI
posts.tagline: Generate and improve your X posts with AI
posts.description: AI-powered X post generator that turns ideas or rough drafts into engaging posts. Create, polish, and optimize your content with AI-generated hooks, tone, and hashtags. No prompt or design skills needed. Grow your brand and audience on X with posts tailored to what you want to say. Free forever with 3 generations/day; PRO removes ads and limits from $3.99/mo.

posts.name: BlazeHive: #1 AI SEO Agent on Autopilot
posts.tagline: Grow organic traffic with this expert steerable AI SEO agent
posts.description: BlazeHive is an AI SEO agent that automates the full organic growth loop: buyer-intent keyword research, humanized content, GEO for AI citations, technical SEO audits, contextual backlinks, FAQs, structured data, and publishing to your CMS. Built for founders, SaaS teams, agencies, marketers, and SEO professionals.

posts.name: OrbisID
posts.tagline: Self-hosted PAM discovery, governance, and compliance
posts.description: OrbisID scans your IT estate — AD, Windows/Linux, cloud, PAM vaults, SaaS, network devices — across 46 system types to automatically discover privileged accounts and entitlements, classify them as human or non-human, and link them to real identities. It reconciles against your existing PAM vault, tracks risk indicators over time, runs owner attestations, and maps findings to NIST, ISO 27001, SOX, HIPAA and Cyber Essentials. Fully self-hosted: your scan data never leaves your network.

posts.name: Starwind UI
posts.tagline: 55 accessible components you own for Astro and React
posts.description: Install 55 styled components or 36 accessible primitives as source you own. Astro and React adapters share one framework-neutral Runtime for consistent DOM behavior. A stable CLI, Skills, and MCP help developers and coding agents work with v3.

posts.name: MakerBadge
posts.tagline: One badge that links every app you've shipped
posts.description: MakerBadge is one line of JS you paste in the footer of each app you ship. It renders a small "Made by @you" badge. Tapping it opens a panel with your other apps and your socials, so a visitor who found one of your products discovers all of them. You edit the list in one place and every badge you have already placed updates within a minute, which means shipping app #4 turns apps #1-3 into doorways to it. 10KB gzipped, no build step, no cookies. Free forever; one-time $19 removes the limits.

posts.name: Stamp Generator
posts.tagline: Turn chat jokes into Discord stamps
posts.description: Turn a message or typed phrase into server emoji, preview options, and register the one you want without leaving Discord. Free, no external AI, and no background channel watching.

posts.name: SwiftQueue
posts.tagline: Stop WordPress doing chores while visitors wait
posts.description: WordPress runs scheduled work—emails, backups, publishing—during a visitor's page load. SwiftQueue moves it to a real background worker. What's different: we publish measured benchmarks with the raw data (the request that triggers cron: 820ms -> 8ms; worst 1% during background work: 835ms -> 62ms). We tell small sites they don't need it. The free core is the whole engine, not a trial. Pro adds WooCommerce checkout protection, priority lanes, alerts, and multisite.

posts.name: Latr
posts.tagline: Remind yourself about any webpage, exactly when you need it.
posts.description: Latr lets you set reminders for webpages, so you can close the tab and come back to the exact page when you need it. Set a reminder, snooze it, make it recurring, or hand it off to your calendar.

posts.name: LocalMuse
posts.tagline: Private AI image generation, entirely on your device
posts.description: LocalMuse is a private, on-device AI image studio for iPhone and iPad. Generate images from text, transform photos, inpaint selected areas, and upscale — all locally on your device. Supports SD 1.5 and SDXL models. Download a model once and keep creating offline. No account, no ads, and no generation server. Generation speed depends on your device and the model you choose.

posts.name: ASTRUM
posts.tagline: Collect cosmic cards, battle bosses, and conquer planets
posts.description: Astrum is a sci-fi card collection strategy game. Collect and upgrade unique cards representing stars, planets, and alien life. Face challenging boss fights to conquer new worlds. I hope you'll like this game, I can't wait to read your feedback

posts.name: SnapFlow
posts.tagline: The verified execution layer for cloud infrastructure.
posts.description: SnapFlow turns natural-language requests into verified DevOps operations. It plans, executes, verifies, and reports before charging, delivering end-to-end, outcome-based automation instead of fixed subscriptions. High-risk actions require human approval, and OIDC connects safely without storing credentials. A CLI agent supports on-premise setups, and its "Company Brain" learns over time to power self-healing.

posts.name: Spronta
posts.tagline: SEO and GEO audits your agents can run (MCP + CLI)
posts.description: Spronta monitors your site's technical SEO, accessibility, and AI-search readiness: scheduled crawls, plain-English fixes, anti-AI slop deterministic rules, regression alerts, shareable team reports, and an MCP endpoint for agents. Generous free tier + open-source local version.

posts.name: TreasuryBench
posts.tagline: A public benchmark for AI financial advice
posts.description: We tested Treasury, Origin, and Monarch on the same real personal-finance questions, scored by an independent AI judge. Treasury scored 89 to Origin’s 71 and Monarch’s 52 — winning all 12 categories with zero dangerous answers. The methodology, scoring code, and raw results are open source.

posts.name: Silent
posts.tagline: The health app that doesn't monetize you.
posts.description: Silent is a $3.99 one-time iOS health tracker with an AI coach that runs entirely on your iPhone via Apple Intelligence. Calories, habits, fasting, sleep, weight - one tool, no subscription, no servers, no data leaving your device.

posts.name: Tutela Scam Defense Toolkit
posts.tagline: Is this a scam? 10 free tools that answer in a minute
posts.description: Free scam checkers for texts (6 countries), websites, romance profiles and refunds, plus an emergency guide for the first hour after being scammed. No account, no tracking. Every verdict ends with the institution's own published rule.

posts.name: Free Image Downloader from Websites
posts.tagline: Free Online Image Downloader: Save Batch Pictures Pinterest
posts.description: How to download any image from a website: easily extract HD photos, bulk save PNG files, and export web galleries to a ZIP archive. Accelerate your visual curation and asset management. Climagex is a precision-engineered bulk image downloader and extraction engine built for speed and workflow fluidity. 🗃️ 1-Click Batch Extraction: Deep-scan any page to harvest hundreds of pictures instantly, packaging them into a single, clean ZIP archive without freezing your browser.

posts.name: AlpineRank
posts.tagline: The GEO audit tool that shows its work
posts.description: Most GEO tools hand you a number. AlpineRank hands you the test: 25 real AI-search questions scored against your page, 6 technical checks, and an honest "unable to verify" when a check fails — dropped from the average, never counted as a pass. Free, no account, ~30 seconds.
